items.title: Disney Q4 earnings beat estimates as parks and streaming keep growing
items.summary: Disney’s fourth quarter earnings beat expectations on Tuesday before the market open, as the media giant’s parks and streaming businesses continued to deliver strong growth.

items.title: Disney theme parks and streaming services thrive as new CEO seeks $3 billion in cost savings
items.summary: Disney's fourth quarter performance beat Wall Street expectations as the entertainment giant's streaming services and theme parks drove revenue growth. Disney also announced on Tuesday that it's looking for $3 billion in cost savings by fiscal 2029.

items.title: Disney beats fourth quarter estimates on streaming growth
items.summary: Investing.com -- Walt Disney Co (NYSE: DIS) reported fourth-quarter adjusted earnings per share of $1.77, surpassing analyst estimates of $1.68, while revenue reached $25.95 billion, beating the consensus of $25.21 billion. Revenue increased 16% YoY from $22.5 billion in the prior-year quarter.

items.title: Why Netflix Stock Is At A One-Year Low
items.summary: Our Nov 16 piece, Can Netflix Stock Fall 50%, found that Netflix (NFLX) has fallen 50% or more from high to low in three of the 15 market shocks it has traded through. That is the crash question. The next question is the one owners live with every day: what is the real risk now, with no shock in sight.
